        "contents": "import { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\nimport { z } from 'zod'\n\nconst createServiceSchema = z.object({\n  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),\n  url: z.url('Invalid URL format'),\n  method: z.enum(['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']).default('GET'),\n  tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]),\n  type: z.enum(['public', 'private']).default('public'),\n})\n\n/**\n * POST /services\n * Add new service (authentication required)\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  verifyAuth(event)\n\n  const validateBody = await readValidatedBody(event, createServiceSchema.safeParse)\n  if (!validateBody.success) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: validateBody.error.message,\n    })\n  }\n\n  const body = validateBody.data\n\n  // Validate required fields\n  if (!body.name || !body.url) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing required fields: name, url',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Insert new monitor\n  const [newService] = await db.insert(schema.services).values({\n    name: body.name,\n    url: body.url,\n    method: body.method,\n    tags: body.tags,\n    type: body.type,\n  }).returning()\n\n  return {\n    monitor: newService,\n  }\n})",

        "contents": "import { and, eq, gte } from 'drizzle-orm'\nimport { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\nexport default defineEventHandler(async () =&gt; {\n  const services = await db.select().from(schema.services)\n  const overviews: ServiceOverview[] = []\n\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant().toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n  const thirtyDaysAgo = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ days: 30 }))\n  const thirtyDaysAgoDate = new Date(thirtyDaysAgo.toInstant().epochMilliseconds)\n\n  for (const service of services) {\n    const serviceLogs = await db\n      .select()\n      .from(schema.serviceLogs)\n      .where(\n        and(\n          eq(schema.serviceLogs.serviceId, service.id),\n          gte(schema.serviceLogs.timestamp, thirtyDaysAgoDate),\n        ),\n      )\n      .orderBy(schema.serviceLogs.timestamp)\n\n    const serviceLogsByDays = manageServiceLogsByDays(serviceLogs)\n    const status = getServiceStatus(serviceLogs)\n\n    const logs: ServiceHistroy[] = Array.from(serviceLogsByDays.entries())\n      .map(([date, logsByDay]) =&gt; ({\n        date: Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from(date),\n        uptime: logsByDay.uptime,\n        latency: logsByDay.latency,\n        outages: logsByDay.outages,\n      }))\n      .sort((a, b) =&gt; a.date.epochMilliseconds - b.date.epochMilliseconds)\n\n    overviews.push({\n      histories: logs,\n      service: {\n        id: service.id,\n        name: service.name,\n        tags: service.tags,\n        url: service.url,\n        status: status ?? ServiceStatus.Down,\n      },\n    })\n  }\n  return {\n    overviews,\n    timestamp: Temporal.Now.instant().toString(),\n  }\n})",

        "contents": "&lt;script setup lang=\"ts\"&gt;\nconst { data } = useQuery({\n  key: ['overview'],\n  query: () =&gt; $fetch('/api/services/overviews'),\n})\n\nconst isSystemHealthy = computed(() =&gt; data.value?.overviews.every(overview =&gt; overview.service.status === ServiceStatus.Operational))\n\nconst activeServices = computed(() =&gt; data.value?.overviews.filter(overview =&gt; overview.service.status === ServiceStatus.Operational).length)\nconst totalServices = computed(() =&gt; data.value?.overviews.length ?? 0)\n\nconst averageUptime = computed(() =&gt; {\n  const uptimes = data.value?.overviews.reduce((acc, overview) =&gt; {\n    const serviceUptime = overview.histories.reduce((acc, history) =&gt; acc + (history.uptime ?? 0), 0) ?? 0\n    return acc + serviceUptime\n  }, 0) ?? 0\n\n  return (uptimes / totalServices.value).toFixed(2)\n})\n&lt;/script&gt;\n\n&lt;template&gt;\n  &lt;div mb-12&gt;\n    &lt;div\n      relative of-hidden",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./server/utils/service.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 113,
            "column": 1
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 199,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export function getServiceStatus(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n): ServiceStatus {\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant()\n  const halfDayAgo = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ hours: 12 }))\n  const halfDayAgoDate = new Date(halfDayAgo.epochMilliseconds)\n\n  // Filter logs from the last 12 hours\n  const recentLogs = logs.filter((log) =&gt; {\n    const logDate = log.timestamp instanceof Date ? log.timestamp : new Date(log.timestamp)\n    return logDate &gt;= halfDayAgoDate\n  })\n\n  // If no logs in the last 12 hours, return down\n  if (recentLogs.length === 0) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Down\n  }\n\n  // Count successful logs (status === 'up')\n  const upCount = recentLogs.filter(log =&gt; log.status === 'up').length\n  const uptime = (upCount / recentLogs.length) * 100\n\n  // Calculate status based on uptime percentage\n  if (uptime &gt;= 99.5) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Operational\n  }\n  else if (uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Degraded\n  }\n  else {\n    return ServiceStatus.Down\n  }\n}\n\nexport function getOutages(histories: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[]) {\n  // Returns an array of outage periods: [{ from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }]\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "export function getServiceStatus(",
            "lineNumber": 116,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": "  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],",

        "contents": "export function getServiceStatus(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n): ServiceStatus {\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant()\n  const halfDayAgo = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ hours: 12 }))\n  const halfDayAgoDate = new Date(halfDayAgo.epochMilliseconds)\n\n  // Filter logs from the last 12 hours\n  const recentLogs = logs.filter((log) =&gt; {\n    const logDate = log.timestamp instanceof Date ? log.timestamp : new Date(log.timestamp)\n    return logDate &gt;= halfDayAgoDate\n  })\n\n  // If no logs in the last 12 hours, return down\n  if (recentLogs.length === 0) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Down\n  }\n\n  // Count successful logs (status === 'up')\n  const upCount = recentLogs.filter(log =&gt; log.status === 'up').length\n  const uptime = (upCount / recentLogs.length) * 100\n\n  // Calculate status based on uptime percentage\n  if (uptime &gt;= 99.5) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Operational\n  }\n  else if (uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Degraded\n  }\n  else {\n    return ServiceStatus.Down\n  }\n}\n\nexport function getOutages(histories: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[]) {\n  // Returns an array of outage periods: [{ from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }]\n}",

        "contents": "export function getOutages(histories: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[]) {\n  // Returns an array of outage periods: [{ from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }]\n  // Outage is defined as contiguous logs where status !== 'up'\n\n  if (!histories || histories.length === 0)\n    return []\n\n  // Make sure logs are ordered\n  const sorted = [...histories].sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n    const aDate = a.timestamp instanceof Date ? a.timestamp.getTime() : new Date(a.timestamp).getTime()\n    const bDate = b.timestamp instanceof Date ? b.timestamp.getTime() : new Date(b.timestamp).getTime()\n    return aDate - bDate\n  })\n\n  const outages: { from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }[] = []\n\n  let inOutage = false\n  let outageStart: Temporal.ZonedDateTime | null = null\n  let lastTimestamp: Temporal.ZonedDateTime | null = null\n\n  for (const log of sorted) {\n    const logDate = log.timestamp instanceof Date\n      ? Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(log.timestamp.getTime()).toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n      : Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(new Date(log.timestamp).getTime()).toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n\n    if (log.status !== 'up') {\n      if (!inOutage) {\n        inOutage = true\n        outageStart = logDate\n      }\n    }\n    else {\n      if (inOutage &amp;&amp; outageStart) {\n        // Outage ends at previous log's timestamp\n        const duration = logDate.since(outageStart)\n        outages.push({ from: outageStart, duration })\n        inOutage = false\n        outageStart = null\n      }\n    }\n    lastTimestamp = logDate\n  }\n\n  // If still in outage at the end, measure until lastTimestamp (last log)\n  if (inOutage &amp;&amp; outageStart &amp;&amp; lastTimestamp) {\n    const duration = lastTimestamp.since(outageStart)\n    outages.push({ from: outageStart, duration })\n  }\n\n  return outages\n}",

        "contents": "export function manageServiceLogsByDays(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n) {\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant().toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n\n  const serviceLogsByDays = new Map(\n    Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) =&gt; {\n      const date = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ days: i }))\n        .startOfDay()\n        .toString()\n      const logsByDay: ServiceLogsByDays = {\n        get total() {\n          return this.logs.length\n        },\n        get upCount() {\n          return this.logs.filter(log =&gt; log.status === 'up').length\n        },\n        get uptime() {\n          return this.upCount / this.total * 100\n        },\n        logs: [],\n        get latency() {\n          return this.logs.at(-1)?.latency ?? null\n        },\n        get outages() {\n          return getOutages(this.logs)\n        },\n      }\n      return [date, logsByDay]\n    }),\n  )\n\n  for (const log of logs) {\n    const date = log.timestamp.toTemporalInstant().toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC').startOfDay()\n    const serviceLogsByDay = serviceLogsByDays.get(date.toString())\n    if (serviceLogsByDay) {\n      serviceLogsByDay.logs.push(log)\n    }\n  }\n\n  return serviceLogsByDays\n}\n\nexport function getServiceStatus(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n): ServiceStatus {\n  \n}",

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "export function manageServiceLogsByDays(",

            "isSignature": true
          },
          {

已完成服务卡片组件的优化，主要变更：

## 主要改进

1. **添加中间部分**：
   - 显示服务标签（Production、Critical 等）
   - 显示性能指标（延迟，带闪电图标）
   - 显示最后检查时间（带时钟图标）
   - 使用垂直分隔线分隔指标

2. **修复在线率计算**：
   - 从硬编码的 100% 改为基于历史数据计算 30 天平均在线率

3. **API 增强**：
   - 在 `ServiceOverview` 类型中添加 `lastCheckTime` 字段
   - 更新 API 以获取并返回最后检查时间

4. **样式优化**：
   - 调整间距，使布局更紧凑
   - 优化标签样式，使其更符合截图设计
   - 改进图标和文本的颜色对比度

组件现在应更接近截图设计，包含所有必要的信息和视觉元素。

        "contents": "import { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\nexport default defineEventHandler(async () =&gt; {\n  const services = await db.select().from(schema.services)\n  const overviews: ServiceOverview[] = []\n\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant().toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n  const thirtyDaysAgo = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ days: 30 }))\n  const thirtyDaysAgoDate = new Date(thirtyDaysAgo.toInstant().epochMilliseconds)\n\n  for (const service of services) {\n    const serviceLogs = await db\n      .select()\n      .from(schema.serviceLogs)\n      .where(\n        and(\n          eq(schema.serviceLogs.serviceId, service.id),\n          gte(schema.serviceLogs.timestamp, thirtyDaysAgoDate),\n        ),\n      )\n      .orderBy(schema.serviceLogs.timestamp)\n\n    // Get the latest log for last check time\n    const latestLog = await db\n      .select()\n      .from(schema.serviceLogs)\n      .where(eq(schema.serviceLogs.serviceId, service.id))\n      .orderBy(desc(schema.serviceLogs.timestamp))\n      .limit(1)\n      .then(logs =&gt; logs[0] ?? null)\n\n    const serviceLogsByDays = manageServiceLogsByDays(serviceLogs)\n    const status = getServiceStatus(serviceLogs)\n\n    const logs: ServiceHistroy[] = Array.from(serviceLogsByDays.entries())\n      .map(([date, logsByDay]) =&gt; ({\n        date: Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from(date),\n        uptime: logsByDay.uptime,\n        latency: logsByDay.latency,\n        outages: logsByDay.outages,\n      }))\n      .sort((a, b) =&gt; a.date.epochMilliseconds - b.date.epochMilliseconds)\n\n    // Convert latest log timestamp to Temporal.ZonedDateTime\n    const lastCheckTime = latestLog\n      ? Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(\n          latestLog.timestamp instanceof Date\n            ? latestLog.timestamp.getTime()\n            : new Date(latestLog.timestamp).getTime(),\n        ).toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n      : null\n\n    overviews.push({\n      histories: logs,\n\n}",

        "contents": "export function getOutages(histories: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[]) {\n  // Returns an array of outage periods: [{ from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }]\n  // Outage is defined as contiguous logs where status !== 'up'\n\n  if (!histories || histories.length === 0)\n    return []\n\n  // Make sure logs are ordered\n  const sorted = [...histories].sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n    const aDate = a.timestamp instanceof Date ? a.timestamp.getTime() : new Date(a.timestamp).getTime()\n    const bDate = b.timestamp instanceof Date ? b.timestamp.getTime() : new Date(b.timestamp).getTime()\n    return aDate - bDate\n  })\n\n  const outages: { from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }[] = []\n\n  let inOutage = false\n  let outageStart: Temporal.ZonedDateTime | null = null\n  let lastTimestamp: Temporal.ZonedDateTime | null = null\n\n  for (const log of sorted) {\n    const logDate = log.timestamp instanceof Date\n      ? Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(log.timestamp.getTime()).toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n      : Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(new Date(log.timestamp).getTime()).toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n\n    if (log.status !== 'up') {\n      if (!inOutage) {\n        inOutage = true\n        outageStart = logDate\n      }\n    }\n    else {\n      if (inOutage &amp;&amp; outageStart) {\n        // Outage ends at previous log's timestamp\n        const duration = logDate.since(outageStart)\n        outages.push({ from: outageStart, duration })\n        inOutage = false\n        outageStart = null\n      }\n    }\n    lastTimestamp = logDate\n  }\n\n  // If still in outage at the end, measure until lastTimestamp (last log)\n  if (inOutage &amp;&amp; outageStart &amp;&amp; lastTimestamp) {\n    const duration = lastTimestamp.since(outageStart)\n    outages.push({ from: outageStart, duration })\n  }\n\n  return outages\n}",

        "contents": "&lt;script setup lang=\"ts\"&gt;\nimport type { SerializeObject } from 'nitropack'\n\nimport { Tooltip } from '@ark-ui/vue/tooltip'\n\nconst props = defineProps&lt;{\n  history: SerializeObject&lt;ServiceHistroy&gt;\n}&gt;()\n\nconst uptimeBgColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.uptime === null) {\n    return 'bg-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.uptime &gt;= 99.9) {\n    return 'bg-emerald-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return 'bg-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'bg-rose-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst uptimeTextColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.uptime === null) {\n    return 'text-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.uptime &gt;= 99.9) {\n    return 'text-emerald-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return 'text-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'text-rose-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst latencyColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.latency === null) {\n    return 'text-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.latency &gt; 800) {\n    return 'text-rose-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.latency &gt; 500) {\n    return 'text-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'text-emerald-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst outages = computed&lt;string[]&gt;(() =&gt;         "contents": "export function getServiceStatus(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n): ServiceStatus {\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant()\n  const halfDayAgo = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ hours: 12 }))\n  const halfDayAgoDate = new Date(halfDayAgo.epochMilliseconds)\n\n  // Filter logs from the last 12 hours\n  const recentLogs = logs.filter((log) =&gt; {\n    const logDate = log.timestamp instanceof Date ? log.timestamp : new Date(log.timestamp)\n    return logDate &gt;= halfDayAgoDate\n  })\n\n  // If no logs in the last 12 hours, return down\n  if (recentLogs.length === 0) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Down\n  }\n\n  // Count successful logs (status === 'up')\n  const upCount = recentLogs.filter(log =&gt; log.status === 'up').length\n  const uptime = (upCount / recentLogs.length) * 100\n\n  // Calculate status based on uptime percentage\n  if (uptime &gt;= 99.5) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Operational\n  }\n  else if (uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Degraded\n  }\n  else {\n    return ServiceStatus.Down\n  }\n}\n\nexport function getOutages(histories: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[]) {\n  // Returns an array of outage periods: [{ from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }]\n}",

        "contents": "export function manageServiceLogsByDays(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n) {\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant().toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n\n  const serviceLogsByDays = new Map(\n    Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) =&gt; {\n      const date = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ days: i }))\n        .startOfDay()\n        .toString()\n      const logsByDay: ServiceLogsByDays = {\n        get total() {\n          return this.logs.length\n        },\n        get upCount() {\n          return this.logs.filter(log =&gt; log.status === 'up').length\n        },\n        get uptime() {\n          return this.upCount / this.total * 100\n        },\n        logs: [],\n        get latency() {\n          return this.logs.at(-1)?.latency ?? null\n        },\n        get outages() {\n          return getOutages(this.logs)\n        },\n      }\n      return [date, logsByDay]\n    }),\n  )\n\n  for (const log of logs) {\n    const date = log.timestamp.toTemporalInstant().toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC').startOfDay()\n    const serviceLogsByDay = serviceLogsByDays.get(date.toString())\n    if (serviceLogsByDay) {\n      serviceLogsByDay.logs.push(log)\n    }\n  }\n\n  return serviceLogsByDays\n}\n\nexport function getServiceStatus(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n): ServiceStatus {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "---\nalwaysApply: true\nglobs: *.vue,*.tsx,*.ts\n---\n**Please adhere to the following rules when handling time-related data:**\n\n1. Ensure that time is maintained in **UTC** within server-side logic.\n2. When displaying time on the client side, ensure it is converted to the user's timezone using &#96;Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone&#96;.\n3. Use **&#96;Temporal&#96;** APIs instead of the &#96;Date&#96; object for time processing.\n4. Since server API responses are serialized into strings when returning JSON data, you must process time data according to the actual type returned by the server. For example, if the server returns a &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime&#96;, the client must use &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from&#96; to reconstruct the &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime&#96; object. The same applies to &#96;Temporal.PlainDateTime&#96;, &#96;Temporal.Instant&#96;, &#96;Temporal.Duration&#96;, etc.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },

            "text": "alwaysApply: true",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "globs: *.vue,*.tsx,*.ts",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**Please adhere to the following rules when handling time-related data:**",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Ensure that time is maintained in **UTC** within server-side logic.",

            "line": 51,
            "column": 2

        },
        "contents": "import { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\nimport { z } from 'zod'\n\nconst createServiceSchema = z.object({\n  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),\n  url: z.url('Invalid URL format'),\n  method: z.enum(['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']).default('GET'),\n  tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]),\n  type: z.enum(['public', 'private']).default('public'),\n})\n\n/**\n * POST /services\n * Add new service (authentication required)\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  verifyAuth(event)\n\n  const validateBody = await readValidatedBody(event, createServiceSchema.safeParse)\n  if (!validateBody.success) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: validateBody.error.message,\n    })\n  }\n\n  const body = validateBody.data\n\n  // Validate required fields\n  if (!body.name || !body.url) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing required fields: name, url',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Insert new monitor\n  const [newService] = await db.insert(schema.services).values({\n    name: body.name,\n    url: body.url,\n    method: body.method,\n    tags: body.tags,\n    type: body.type,\n  }).returning()\n\n  return {\n    monitor: newService,\n  }\n})",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
